notes.title: v3.0.7 - Updates from Discord Feedback
notes.content:
This patch took a little bit to push out but we have some improvements based on feedback we got from the discord (you should join the discord if you aren't already, it's on the Steam page on the right side)

- It was brought up that if you get into the Options menu from the Title menu of the game with the mouse, you can't then use the mouse to leave that menu, so we've added an X to close the Options menu so now you can either use the escape key or the mouse to enter, and then use the same thing to leave!

- Finishing a dungeon brought you to the old dungeon select menu, which could allow you to access the Mountain dungeon (under maintenance) and crash the game. You can no longer get to that old pesky menu!

- Fixed some grammar on text when losing a fight
- Fixed some scaling when winning a fight based on the size of the new sprites in combat. Sprites shouldn't obscure text in the ending scnene of a fight
- Linere and Exp bonuses should no longer obscure the player health windows in combat. Their new location is temporary
- The troll sat too high in combat and it's status bar was obscured by the Mechanics bar for the fight. The troll has been lowered in the fight. Hopefully that won't have any negative ramifications for the Dire wolf placement in combat as well.

notes.title: UI and Artwork Refresh
notes.content:
[h3]We've given the game a fresh new coat of paint and fixed a lot of issues! We upgraded both the UI and combat artwork, and players are taking a boat back to the Forest for this round of testing![/h3]


[h1]UI[/h1]

We've revamped the UI from scratch to look even better and let you navigate even faster. No part was left untouched:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43473508/486059a0a8e04a737e4066e570222f1b1d6ae1a3.gif[/img]
New title menu! TheLemurToast knocked it out of the park with the assets for this!!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43473508/b01ea51fadbe56672f9496b06bf176fe5c9b2ef9.png[/img]
New dungeon selection screen! (the finishing touches for this are still in the works, but at least you get a taste)



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43473508/024385fe5e9d4d286b9769638d0a71738129b991.png[/img]
New combat UI!
[list]
[*]You can now see every player's HP and Stacks at any time in combat
[*]Reorganized the placement of skill icons to give some room to the battlers (and there is now some space in the bottom left for a camera)
[*]New combat ending screen
[*]New alchemy screen
[*]New inventory screen
[/list]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43473508/e84469c7ec8860ae287a3127d851be886c76ef64.png[/img]
Context Menu. Every part of the game now has a menu the streamer can bring up that lets you see the relevant commands for that phase. For example, during dungeon exploration, it will list commands like !shop and !inv, among others



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43473508/faef2d37eae9560e3e479bb1ccce0aae9b8aa6e2.png[/img]
We also added a reminder to mod the game's bot account on Twitch to the bottom of the screen (if you haven't already). Clicking the notification will copy the command to your clipboard so it can be pasted in your chat.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43473508/aa9f15167ccac69b0a9112e192fd80f6434d7671.png[/img]
Players purchasing Items from the shop, or the shop refreshing, generates a notification in game on the left side



[h1]Artwork[/h1]

Every player class and enemy type have all received a new look in combat. Alongside those, the title screen and dungeon selection screens are now one and have a lively background.


[h1]Misc.[/h1]

[list]
[*] Players can no longer see the HP of enemies;
[*] Added voice lines for the Solicitor;
[*] The Forest dungeon is back, and players can no longer access the Mountain. It's under renovation so come back later!
[/list]

Barring any critical issues, this will be the last patch for a while, because we're rebuilding the game essentially from scratch! We're making good progress though, so hopefully the wait won't be too long.

[i][h2]We're looking forward to your feedback![/h2][/i]

notes.title: v3.0.5 Patch
notes.content:
[h1]Bard Skill Update[/h1]

Skill F - Balladeer's Overture has been modified. 

This skill now will consume all Crescendo and Serenade stacks on use. 

For every Crescendo Stack consumed, a random Debuff is applied to all enemies. The application rates for each Debuff is still taken into account

For every Serenade Stack consumed, a random Buff is applied to all allies. 

[h1]Solicitor[/h1]

Images have been added in for all Solicitor skills.

[h1]Start Combat before countdown timer ends[/h1]

There is now a button in the join window when you encounter enemies in a dungeon. Clicking it will immediately start combat with whoever is currently in the party. No need to wait 35 more seconds if everyone in your chat has already joined.

[h1]Salamander[/h1]

Whenever the Salamander uses its Fireblast attack, it attacks all players in a line in front of it. Sometimes there is no player there though, such as if a Harpy picks a player up. When this happens, the skill has nothing to hit, waiting for an event that will never occur, and hangs until you skip it's turn or leave the dungeon. This should now be fixed. (Thank you KeenReflex and chat for catching this on your stream!)

notes.title: v3.0.4 - Harpies and Health
notes.content:
[h2]Harpies[/h2]

Harpies are supposed to let go of players that they are holding when they die. Now they do that!

[h2]Health[/h2]

When playing the game at higher difficulties, the health bars for enemies get weird and don't visually update until their health value get's low enough to reflect their base health value again. This has been fixed so they always update properly

The command !health now shows the current/max health values of any player that isn't at full health so you have exactly the information you need when you use the command.

notes.title: Major Rework: Combat
notes.content:
We've had issues with the combat system for a while, constant hiccups that requires the streamer to skip the current players turn to kick the game back in gear again. This change should alleviate a big number of those issues. We've also had bug reports sent back to the discord page (which you can find on the steam page on the right hand side). Many of those bugs have been addressed in this patch with more in the coming days. 

- Acquiring the Max Stacks NPC buff would not display on a character when you loaded into battle. You now properly get those stacks when you enter combat.

- !contracts on solicitor wasn't showing the actively held contracts. We've loosened the patrons tongue so they will properly relay that now.

- Solicitor B/C skills weren't working properly. This has been addressed.

notes.title: Mountain Dungeon Release!!
notes.content:
[h1]New Dungeon - Mountain[/h1]

Ahead of you is a climb up a Mountain covered lava, riddled with dangerous enemies. This Dungeon has lots of divergent paths so try not to get lost as you scale to the top. There are very strong fights here, so be prepared for the journey ahead.



[h1]New Enemies[/h1]

[h2]Harpy[/h2]

Harpies can pick up players, immobilizing them for a turn. When the Harpy takes it’s turn again, it will do a large amount of damage to the player that was picked up. However, if the Harpy takes damage while holding a player, there’s a chance they will drop the player.

Some Harpies will prioritize a player being held by another Harpy.

[h2]Salamander[/h2]

Salamanders are tanky and can shoot fire in a straight line ahead, doing to players ahead of them.

[h2]Kobold[/h2]

Kobolds are ambush predators and will attack as a group whenever one of them attacks. They attack with weapons in hand, ranged weapons, and incomplete draconic magic.



[h1]New Bosses[/h1]

[h2]Dragon[/h2]

The Dragon has a passive that generates a powerful aura around it, making it difficult to land attacks on them. Beware of their powerful breath attack!

[h2]Fire Giant[/h2]

The Fire Giant is an embodiment of heat so great that standing near it burns clothing. Don’t let the fight draw out too much or it may be hard to overcome all that extra damage in the fight.

notes.title: Pre-DreamHack Update: Tutorial!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Tutorial[/b][/h2]

The game has a learning curve so it's about time we introduce a simple Tutorial for the game. This can be accessed from the Main Menu. It isn't required to do anything in the game, but I suggest you run through it once to get an idea of how the game plays before jumping into a dungeon with your community. 

A special thanks to Emily from [url=https://www.twitch.tv/playguepals]PlayguePals[/url] for doing the voice acting for the Tutorial, it came out great!!

We also have a website for the game, https://www.falfan.stream -- that you can use to get more info about how classes work, different commands for the game, and who has been working on the project with us so be sure to check that out as well!

Now on to the rest of the patch notes:

[h2][b]Random Encounters[/b][/h2]

We now have procedural random encounters in the game now instead of specific rooms having a fight at a specific point in that room. Every room except for the room you start the dungeon in and the boss room will have a chance for random encounters, but once you have a fight in that room you cannot fight again there so killing the boss and jumping back in is your best bet for exp grinding. 

In addition, increasing the difficulty of the game increases the chance of encounters.

[h2][b]Miscellaneous Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Streamer can now always vote on the NPC action, even if they are in combat. No more sitting and waiting for chatters to tell the NPC what to do.
[*] Fixed an issue where Linere and Experience weren't awarded if there was only 1 enemy to fight.
[*] Fixed a layering issue in combat where you hover over the text on the bottom right and the tooltip showed up underneath the skill icons.
[/list]

[h2][b]Discord Integration[/b][/h2]

If you happen to look in the Connections tab of the Menu, you'll see that Discord has been added to the list. Discord integration has made it into the game but it isn't working exactly how we want it so please give me a little bit of time to tweak it to proper working conditions before attempting to connect your account. I will be making a short tutorial video on YouTube detailing how to create your Discord bot and connect it to the game. I'm really excited for this feature and it will be my #1 goal when we come back from DreamHack. Speaking of...

[h2][b]DreamHack - Atlanta GA[/b][/h2]

We have a booth at DreamHack to show off the game so if you are in the area or plan on being at the con itself then make sure to swing by our booth and meet some of the team! It's going to be a great weekend!

notes.title: Update v2.0.2.0 -- The Timeline
notes.content:
It's been a minute, let's catch you up.

[b][h1]The Timeline[/h1][/b]

We've changed how the combat system works internally. This isn't something you will actually see, but has made building skills and pacing out the turn much easier to work in. This will result in smoother, more consistent gameplay and less bugs/crashes. 

Let's talk about some changes you will see:

[list]
[*] [b]Alchemist Crafting[/b] - Crafting a potion will announce to the chat what items you use, making it more clear about what the player did. Example: !asb p1 will tell everyone in chat "@{player} used an Average catalyst with a Soothe Bloom reagent!"

[*] [b]Skills that don't end the turn[/b] - An message will be posted in the chat when a player uses a skill that doesn't end their turn, letting them know that they get to take another action.

[*] [b]Using Combat Skills Incorrectly[/b] - The game now responds when a player uses a skill without all the needed information, such as a target, and lists what targets are available and how to format the command. This is especially useful to newer players.

[*] [b]Skills that don't affect Bosses[/b] - The game will now not let you use a skill that cannot affect bosses if a boss is the only thing in combat. Exmaple: Druid Vines don't affect bosses. If you use Vines against the Troll, the game will let you know that that skill won't do anything here and allow you to choose a new skill

[*] [b]Balladeer's Overture[/b] - The Bard skill, Balladeer's Overture, will play an animation on each enemy regardless of if the skill affects the enemy. If the enemy is affected, it will get the toad status on the status bar (toad model will replace the enemy model in a later patch).
[/list]


This Timeline update took a long time to make and pushed back a lot of work, but it was very needed so that we had a better foundation to continue building the game, so thank you so much for your patience. 

Expect the major update to include a Tutorial for the game and Discord integration!

Don't forget to check out our website as well for more detailed information for the game: www.falfan.stream

notes.title: Update v2.1.0.7 -- LVL 50 Class Skills Update (AND MORE!)
notes.content:
All classes have finally received their lvl 50 skills, let's go over them!

Alchemist - Grand Conversion

	Grand Conversion is an AoE attack (hits all enemies). What effect the skill will have depends on what debuffs enemies have. Debuffs are broken down into 4 Categories:
	- Damage Over Time (burn, poison, etc)
	- Immobility (frozen, bind, etc)
	- Status Debuff (Atk down, Def down, etc)
	- Provoke (This one is just kind of in it's own class)

	Any Damage Over Time debuffs immediately hit for their full damage amount and are cleared off

	Immobility Debuffs on an enemy apply the Def Down Status Debuff

	Provoke on an enemy will apply the Atk Down Status Debuff

	Any Status Debuffs on an enemy will apply all other Status Debuffs

Bard - Balladeer's Overturn

	Balladeer's Overture is an AoE debuff skill that turns enemies into Toads (toad Debuff). Toads take increased damage and deal reduced damage. Bosses cannot be turned into a toad. 
	This skill also modifies Serenade to target 3 players instead of 1. Grants a Crescendo Stack.
	
Crystalsmith - Crystalline Fracture

	Crystalline Fracture is a single target attack that can only be used while under the effect of Soul Forge. It consumes all SF stacks to deal damage to an enemy, the number of hits equal to the number of stacks consumed.
	
Druid - Aspect of the Wild

	Aspect of the Wild grants you a random aspect (Bear, Elk, or Owl), empowering the next use of that Shapehsift. You cannot get a new aspect until the one you have is used. These effects are added to your Form: 
	Bear Form - Adds Provoke and increases the damage of your attack. 
	Elk Form - Cleanses up to 2 debuffs from each player. 
	Owl Form - Adds Attack Buff in addition to Crit Buff to all players.
	
Rogue - Steal Artifact


* this skill isn't actually useful as of yet, as Artifacts have not been added to the game. You'll learn more about these on a later update*

	Steal Artifact increases the drop rate of Class Artifacts from Boss fights. Grants a Pilfer Stack.

Warrior - Adrenaline

	Adrenaline heals the Warrior for a % of their maximum health. After 3 turns, that health is then removed as damage done to the Warrior.
	
Wizard - Arcane Rupture

	Arcane Rupture is a single target attack that requires a Maxed Elemental Stack to use. It consumed a Maxed Stack to deal damage to an enemy. If any other elemental stack is maxed, it will chain those elements into this one, consuming their stacks as well.


How to Play Scene Update!!

	The How to Play scene just a visual update that makes it easier to navigate, and also cleaned up some of the language to make it less of a novel to read.
	Please feel free to provide any feedback on this change.


Other Changes!!

	- Alchemist lvl 1 Skill, Spontaneous Combustion, is now an AoE attack.
	- We now visualize any Linere and EXP buffs receieved in combat to the left of the skill icons. This will help track buffs from things like Rogue Steals.
	- We've changed how Damage and Heal values pop off of players and enemies to clarify information. This was mainly due to an issue where sometimes if a player/enemy had multiple damage debuffs at the same time, each value would pop off the player/enemy at the same time, making any individual value unreadable. Now damage values generate around entities, moving away from them towards the outer areas of the screen, pushing each other out the way if they make contact. Healing values push inwards towards the center of the screen.

notes.title: Introduction of Combat NPC!
notes.content:
We have finally introduced the Combat NPC, a group controlled entity in combat that is spawned in whenever a 9th person tried to join combat, or if a chatter tries to join after combat has already started!

This NPC is controlled by everyone in chat that doesn't actively have a character in combat. The NPC can be turned off in the settings, along with changing the countdown timer to vote on NPC actions. Speaking of those--

The NPC will spawn in with 3 skill types: A healing skill, a support skill, and a damage skill. The skill in each those categories is chosen at random, based on skills from the 7 classes in the game! This means that the NPC will have a different skill set every time it joins the fight. 

The NPC cannot be dealt damage, healed, or otherwise interacted with, and fights will still be lost when all players have fallen even if the NPC is present. The skills given to the NPC are not final, this is kind of a trial run to see how effective it is and what feedback we can get for the implementation. More skills will be added down the line. 

[b]ALSO[/b]

We have reworked the How To Play scene to be less of a massive text dump, and easier to navigate. After watching some new players give the game a shot, I quickly realized this is a hurdle to take in at first, and is usually skipped all together which makes the rest of the play experience pretty awful. I will also be making a simple tutorial to ease newer streamers into the game as well.


Minor Bug fix: 

Fixed the mushroom's Poison AoE attack to not hit each player 1 at a time, instead hitting all players simultaneously (as intended)

notes.title: v2.0.1.3 - **All Class Lvl 40 Skills and QoL Changes!!**

Level 40 Skills!!

Druid Skill - Tempest (Passive Skill)

  Tempest is an Upgrade to Whirlwind. Whirlwind damage increased and gives a chance for an extra Shapeshift Stack for every enemy hit.

Alchemist Skill - Freebie (Passive Skill)

  Freebie gives a chance for any craft to not consume materials.

Crystalsmith Skill - Stand Tall (Passive Skill)

  Gives a 30% DPS boost when hitting bosses and challenged enemies.

Bard Skill - Encore (Passive Skill)

   Modifies Tune Performance, Dissonance, Invigorate, and Fortissimo. Gives a % chance that each of these skills turns into an AoE.

Warrior Skill - I'll Be Your Shield (Active Skill)

  Shields an ally for 3 turns, taking any damage that they would receive (does not trigger with AoE attacks dealt to players)

Rogue Skill - Critical Weakness (Passive Skill)

  When you land a critical hit, heal yourself based on the damage dealt.

Wizard Skill - Mystic Implosion (Passive Skill)

  % chance that your elemental skills will proc Mystic Implosion, increasing damage dealt


Pause

  Opening the Options Menu will pause the game. Sorry this one took so long.

Ally System

  Whenever you finish a fight with a party, you get an ally point towards each member of that party. Whenever you trigger Helping Hand, your partner's damage is increased based on the number of ally points you have with them. This damage value is uncapped.


**Bug Fixes**


- Updated !statuses command and added Tooltips for E skills

- Updated Tooltips for Troll Boss

- Counterattack (Warrior Passive) properly changes the turn when killing an enemy

- Wolf Pups now leave the battlefield when they die

- Fixed Bosses Defeated total in the stats menu not adding correctly. Your total bosses defeated number will automatically be updated to the correct value.

- Wizards and Alchemists can have friends now!

  (Both classes were unable in some instances to trigger Helping Hand. That has been fixed.)


**Changes**


- New Icons for Druid Skills

- Updated shop refresh message to be cleaner (Thank you KeenReflex)

LOOK HERE

- Attacks that don't need a target (AoEs and self buffs) no longer need a target in the command. Example: Warrior D skill (Cyclone) can be used with !d

- Skills/items that affect players can now be used with @username as an alternative to p1/p2/p3/etc. Example: Alchemists B skill (Healing Salve) can be used with the command !b @falinere

notes.title: v2.0.1.2 -- Lvl 30 Class skills!

v2.0.1.2 - **All Class lvl 30 Skills!**

[b]**New Things**[/b]


Level 30 skills!!

Druid Skill - Owl Form (Active Skill)

  Owl Form is a Shapeshift skill that gives all allies a crit rate boost (# of turns with the buff based on the number of Shapeshift Stacks you have) and attacks an enemy. At Max Stacks, applies a bleed to the enemy."

Alchemist Skill - Bio (Active Skill)

Crystalsmith Skill - Challenge (Active Skill)

  Challenge puts a debuff on an enemy for 2 turns. If the enemy is defeated in those 2 turns, the you regain 80 health. If it is not defeated, it regains 150 health.

Bard Skill - Resonance (Active Skill)

  Resonance is a single target attack that has a chance to apply Atk Down debuff and brings in an ally to attack with you (the ally you bring with you is random and can also apply a debuff specific to that class). Grants a Crescendo Stack.

Warrior Skill - Counterattack (Passive Skill)

  Counterattack is just what it sounds like, when you are attacked you attack back. Only applies when you are hit with a single target melee attack. Gives a Fervor Stack when you counter.

Rogue Skill - Stinging Nettle (Active Skill)

  Stinging Nettle is an AoE damage skill that has a chance to land bleed on each enemy.  Grants a Pilfer Stack and can be used with Assassin's Charge.

Wizard Skill - Arcane Influence (Active Skill)

notes.title: Patch v2.0.1.1 - New Skills, New Boss, Queue System, QoL Changes
notes.content:
@Path Notes

v2.0.1.1 - **Troll Boss for Forest and lvl 20 skills!**

**New Things**


- NEW BOSS : Troll
		Passive - Trollskin
				Heals itself every turn by % of max health. When the fight starts, a random debuff is chosen. If the Troll starts its turn with the debuff, it won't heal itself (and a message is sent to chat)
				When the boss hits a player, has a chance to apply Malabsorbtion (reduces incoming healing by 50%)
		Mechanics:
				Sturdy like Rock: On this phase, Troll takes half damage but deals reduced damage
				True Strength: Gains DPS UP for 2 turns
				Might of the Troll: AoE attack

- NEW SKILLS - lvl 20 passives
	Alchemist: Item Mastery - Chance to recover a catalyst of a lower tier when you craft an item (does not work on impure crafts, but does work on free crafts)
	Bard: Rehearsal - When you have the Tune Performance buff and you land a critical hit, you do 2x damage instead of 1.5x
	Crystalsmith:  {Coming Soon}
	Druid: Thorns - If an enemy dies while bound by your vines, it will spread Thorns to all other enemies (DoT)
	Rogue: Hide - When you dodge an attack, you become hidden (next hit is guaranteed critical hit - only applies to the first hit of a multi-hit attack)
	Wizard: Mystic Expansion - Fire/Ice/Thunder have a chance to become AoE, but still only award 1 stack
	
- QUEUE SYSTEM
	Skill queue system added. Use any skill while it isn't your turn to add that skill to your queue, which will then automatically be used when your turn comes back around. If the target for your skill is no longer available, the game will randomly choose you another target. The queue will not use multiple skills in the same turn (Rogues A skill into C skill, for example)
	
- NEW COMMANDS:
	!queue/que/q - Relays what skills you currently have in your queue
	!queue stop - Removes all skills from your queue

- STATS PAGE
	Stats page in the Options Menu properly relays game stats such as enemies defeated. This isn't retroactive for enemies (sorry)


**Bug Fixes**


[list]
[*]  Fixed issue with bosses not dieing properly
[*]  Alchemy lines now play properly when crafts are made
[*]  Correctly relaying bosses defeated when you finish a fight that doesn't have a boss in it
[/list]

**Changes**


[list]
[*]  Rogue steal option (damage) replaced with a Linere multiplier
[*]  !enemies command now also returns enemy HP%
[*]  New template for !skills relay
[*]  Enemies dieing on their turn no longer cause players to play dialogue lines as if they've killed the enemy
[*]  How to Play menu now includes newly added things in game
[/list]

notes.content:
[b]New Things[/b]

Level 10 skills for all classes (and lvl 20 skill for warrior)
Warrior
  - Lvl 10 Passive: Defender/Berserker : When hit 3 times, gain Berserk Stance (raises crit rate by 10%). When you use C skill (cleave), gain Defender Stance (reduce damage taken by 25%)

notes.title: v2.0.0.6 -- Linere
notes.content:
Players can earn COIN! (Linere)


[list]
[*] Enemies drop Linere when they are defeated
[*] Rogues - when they perform a successful steal, also gain some Linere. Amount gained is determined by the tier of the steal (higher levels give higher tiers of steal rewards)
[*] Linere cannot be spent in the shop yet, this will be fixed in a later patch
[/list]

Fixed an Issue where a 4th enemy could be attacked but not actually exist in the fight.

The game now sends a chat message when the players win, this message relays how much Linere was awarded from defeated enemies.

Soul Forge now properly responds when you have gained it, when you lose it, and when you can use it again.

Issue with druid’s bind. Enemies that were binded were also eating turns from players too. This has been fixed.

Issue with players who gain enough exp in a fight to skip a level. Visual animations show that they reached the new level, but the game didn’t give them the second level, resulting in a player with over 1k exp on a class. This has been fixed. 

Players who are level 50 will no longer receive exp, although the ending scene will still animate as if you did (this will be fixed in a later patch)

notes.title: Enemy Spawning Update and more...
notes.content:
[list]


Big Enemy Spawning Update:
[*] Up to 4 enemies can now be spawned in non-boss encounters
1 enemy is added for every odd player in combat

[*] Leaving Combat and joining doesn’t eat an available space. Players will be inserted into the appropriate place in the turn order if that take a spot that was previously held by a player that left the combat encounter
[*] Bosses now have scaling HP, Dire wolf now summons up to 3 pups
[*] Wolf Pups cannot be brought in with Pack Tactics if they are immobilized
[*] Players cannot be brought in with Helping Hand if they are immobilized
[*] Enemies now pass their turn when they die from a status effect
[*] Preserve empty space in the turn order window when an enemy dies to more clearly show which enemy is which based on their position in the info window
[*] Voting on the direction to move directly after combat doesn’t repeat
[/list]

We will be working on and pushing the Inventory Update next week, this should be one of the last big patches before the release of the Demo. Make sure to use the Feedback form in-game to submit feedback to us!
